reviews.text: I waited for 3 hours and 10 minutes and they didn't attend to me. There were always other people ahead of me, and they always told them there were two people ahead of me, but they let a lot of people go ahead. I decided to leave after 3 hours, and my dog ​​wasn't new.

THANK YOUUU Dr Carter for saving my dog Ruby!!!
We needed emergency surgery after she swallowed a piece of her rope toy, and Dr Carter squeezed  Ruby into her busy schedule to save her life. Special things to Patricia as well and the rest of the kind staff who took care of Ruby and we’re also so kind and compassionate  to me during this emotional and extremely scary situation. I would recommend Dr. Carter to anyone, she knows what she is doing.

Terrible service. You arrive before they open, and then they open late. If they're supposed to open at 8:30, they open at 9:00. And if you arrived first, it doesn't matter; they serve whoever they feel like. You come early hoping to be served early.

I went yesterday for the first time and I liked the service very much. I did not feel pressured like it happens in other vet offices. Dr. Arana and Ivette were great. They explained everything, gave me options and were super friendly, specially Ivette.

I was honestly just going to let this slide, but after getting hung up on in my face and having the staff flat-out refuse to put me in contact with the owner, I'm writing this review.
My mom has been bringing our pets and rescues here for years. First off, they basically never answer the phone. Whenever you bring it up in person, the front desk acts completely clueless like they have no idea what you're talking about. We have an older rescue cat who had a dental procedure here before that went fine, but her ear infection has been a constant back-and-forth issue. They just keep throwing medications at it that only work while she’s on them, and the second you stop, it comes right back. It’s not curing anything.
Fast forward to today, she was scheduled for another dental procedure to remove teeth. They told my mom to drop her off at 8:30 AM, and my mom was the second person in line that morning. Fasting was required, so our poor 14-year-old cat hadn’t eaten anything since 8 PM the night before.  When I was leaving work, I called to check if she was ready. Of course, nobody answered. I just drove straight there. When I got there, they told me they hadn’t even started on her yet. She had been sitting there all day fasting with no updates, no one checking in, nothing. A simple phone call to let us know they were running behind would have sufficed.
When my mom arrived, she wanted to speak to Dr. Carter. I’ve spoken to Dr. Carter before over the phone and she seemed very nice, but today was completely different. She told us she was having a bad day, that her daughter was sick, and that she had no one to watch her (her young daughter was present). My mom told her that this whole situation was unacceptable and we weren't happy. Dr. Carter literally replied with, "Well, I don't care if you're happy or not, the cat is fine," and said she wasn't going to get into it in front of her daughter.
My mom told her she understood, she raised three kids as a single mom herself and gets that people have bad days, but that doesn't excuse the FRONT desk not giving clients a quick call. Dr. Carter called us rude and slammed the door. At that point, we did not feel safe leaving our senior cat there, so we told the front desk we were taking her home. Dr. Carter came back out wanting to talk in an exam room, saying again that her kid is sick and she won't be disrespected in front of her. My mom simply said, "Then she shouldn't be here." Nobody was screaming or yelling, it's just the truth—a vet clinic during a customer dispute is no place for a sick child.
On my way home, I called back because I wanted to speak to the owner or manager about how we were treated. To my surprise, someone actually picked up. I asked for the owner's number, and the girl said, "Yes, let me get the owner's number from my personal phone," and put me on hold.
After waiting on hold, a completely different, rude lady picks up and says, "We don't give out personal numbers, I can give you the email." I told her, "Sorry, I was just talking to someone else and she said she was going to grab the number off her personal cell." The lady bluntly snapped back: "I can give you the email or I can hang up on you."
I was in absolute shock that someone working a front desk would talk to a client like that. I told her, "Well can you let her know she's giving out the wrong information then?" She gave a sarcastic laugh and went, "Yeah sure, I'll tell her." I told her fine, I’ll just take the email. She said the first letter of the email address and hung up on me. Tried calling back a million times, but of course no answer.
I can't believe the attitude, the lack of communication, and the way this place is being run. I am leaving this here to give the OWNER one chance to reach out directly and set this right. I will give them until Monday to contact me; if I do not hear back by Monday, 8/31/2026, I will be moving forward with filing my complaints and reports to every veterinary, business, and state board and agency I can. Until then, I’d seriously advise people to take their pets elsewhere.

I had a wonderful experience at the Animal Welfare Society, especially during what was a very stressful emergency with my dog. Dr. Carter was extremely sweet, patient, and helpful. She took the time to answer all of my questions and address every concern I had, which made me feel much more comfortable and reassured.

They also took my dog in immediately when we arrived with an emergency, and I truly appreciated how quickly and compassionately they handled the situation. The staff was caring and professional throughout the entire experience. I’m very grateful to Dr. Carter and the entire team for taking such great care of my dog. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate and trustworthy veterinary care!

Doctor Carter saved our Pedro’s life he had stones blocking his urinary path. They did an amazing job performing surgery with our dog immediately , Patricia was great with him too , they kept him him safe as my daughter went everyday to attend him we are so thankful that places like this exist, they helped in so many ways gave us hope when we thought we were going to have to put him down  because of our finances, great work you guys you have an amazing team, thank you form the bottom of our hearts. See you soon

I don’t have enough words to express how grateful my family and I are to Dr. Andrew Kushnir and the entire team.

We brought in a little stray cat that we cared for every day, never imagining how serious her condition was. From the beginning, Dr. Kushnir showed incredible compassion, empathy, and humanity. He went above and beyond for her and for our family, especially my daughters, keeping us updated and helping us through an incredibly difficult situation.

Sadly, we lost our little girl, but we will always be grateful knowing that everything possible was done for her and that she was treated with so much care and dignity.

Dr. Kushnir, thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Your kindness meant more to us than you will ever know. I would absolutely recommend Dr. Kushnir and this team to anyone looking for compassionate veterinary care.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about the Animal Welfare Society of South Florida. My dog  recently had emergency bladder stone surgery here, and the level of care, professionalism, and compassion shown by this organization has been nothing short of remarkable.

This isn't my first experience with AWS, I've brought a previous dog here before, and every single time, the care has been exceptional. The surgeons, veterinarians, and entire team go above and beyond for their patients. They didn't just perform surgery; they treated Frankie with the utmost compassion while keeping me informed every step of the way.

What really stands out is how AWS balances the serious medical care needed with genuine kindness. I know my pets are in the best possible hands when I'm there. The staff and surgeons should be commended for the remarkable work they do day in and day out under challenging circumstances.

If you care about your pet and want a team that truly gives their all, AWS is the place. Thank you for everything you did for Frankie and for being such an incredible resource for our community.

Thank you for caring for and healing Milaneso, my kitten, for Patricia's dedication, and for the professionalism of Dr. González and the entire staff for their love and care for all the pets and for assisting us in our times of greatest need.
Slow service but very reasonable prices.
Terrible experience. trash customer service. Rude employee. Hire better people not your own family

Terrible place they treat you so bad especially the people handling the front. Disgusting attitudes. Especially blonde girl with glasses. Theres 10,000 qualified front office people waiting for an opportunity, and better talent out there. They don’t care about people.

What a great place and experience for my dog. From the front office to the doctor, all were on point and courteous. German, was very attentive, understanding and knowledgeable. Dr. Carter is very very knowledgeable, to the point with no hesitation and confident. Her many years experience really shines though. We felt safe and knew exactly was going to be done and how. It truly was a great experience. Once your pet is in the hands of a caring knowledgeable, experienced doctor all your worries are gone. Thank you!!!
I brought my dog ​​in and the service was excellent with Manuel, our technician. Thank you, Dr. Carter, and Patricia for taking care of her in the ICU.
Love it here, always professional vets with lots of experience. They don't take advantage of your pet worriness. And with reasonable price.
Dr. Gonzalez, Dr. Carter, the ICU technician Patricia, and all the staff are wonderful, and above all, the prices are great! Thank you so much!

Took my female Siamese cat to AWS for an emergency, and everyone from the moment I walked in, made sure to care for her well being. From the kind young lady at the front desk, to the people directly dealing with her (Herman & Dr. Carter 🙏🏻) who literally saved her life, and continued to follow-up with me, to see how she was doing. If you love your pet as much as I do, these are the professionals you want to have on their side. May God bless the staff at AWS of SFL and all the glory to our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
Doesn’t answer the phone
This place is great. Not fancy just excellent care by an excellent caring staff for very reasonable fees.
They were so loving and kind when I had to put my baby down.

Best Animal Hospital I've ever been to
Great stuff. Friendly environment they take care of your family. Your pets
Great service. Friendly staff. Super caring and attentive. The meds are also priced a lot lower in the clinic than elsewhere. I had my dog’s surgery here and it was great! Recommend it 1000%.

My life companion passed away this Saturday. I don’t have enough words to thank this clinic—the doctor, the nurses, the receptionists, and even the other people in the waiting room who cried with me. An extraordinary team, 100% compassionate and humane. They allowed me to give my 10-year-old kitty the most beautiful goodbye in the world. The medical, emotional, and psychological support they gave me goes beyond words. Forever grateful ❤️🙏🏻

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at this animal clinic. After my dog underwent a procedure, she wasn’t looking too good and  I immediately tried contacting the clinic multiple times, but no one answered the phone. On the rare occasions they do pick up, my calls are either hung up on or I’m sent straight to voicemail without any real assistance. When you’re worried about your pet’s health, this kind of lack of communication is completely unacceptable.

On top of that, I’ve been trying to get a copy of my dog’s bloodwork results. It took two full days just to finally reach someone, and even then, they still have not sent over the paperwork as promised. This kind of delay and lack of follow-through only adds more stress to an already worrying situation.

I trusted this clinic with my pet’s care, but the poor communication, lack of urgency, and unprofessional behavior have made this a frustrating and disappointing experience. I would not recommend this place to other pet owners who expect timely care, compassion, and proper support for their animals.

I have been a client of Animal Welfare Clinic for over 15 years, and I highly recommend it to everyone. Throughout all these years, my experience has always been extraordinary. The entire staff and veterinarians are amazing--friendly, professional, and, most importantly, truly compassionate toward both animals and their owners. I am very grateful to all of them. A special thanks to Manuel, who has taken care of my dogs for many years.

The Animal Welfare Society has been absolutely extraordinary for my dog, Eli, and for me.

I originally found them while searching online for a veterinary clinic that was compassionate, practical, and willing to help us navigate a difficult situation. From the very beginning, their team was empathetic, thoughtful, and deeply committed to Eli’s care.

When Eli was first seen for pink eye, they were attentive and thorough. When a growth on his skin became a concern, they helped initiate the next steps and guided me through the process of getting him the care he needed. Later, when he began showing signs of what seemed like a UTI—which turned out to be a very serious, life-threatening condition involving severe prostatitis—they once again went above and beyond for us.

What stands out most about this team is not just their medical care, but their humanity. They took my concerns seriously, helped me navigate difficult decisions, were realistic with me when quality-of-life conversations had to happen, and celebrated with me when Eli pulled through. That combination of honesty, compassion, and dedication is incredibly rare.

They are true lifesavers, and I genuinely do not have words strong enough to express how grateful I am for everything they have done.

Special thanks to Dr. Carter, Dr. Davila, Herrmann, and Valeria. Your kindness, hard work, and heart mean more than I can say.

Recently rescued a puppy and had to find a vet that wouldn’t charge me thousands. This was an amazing find! Very reasonably priced and although they take walk ins would highly recommend making an appointment. They usually will give it to you a day or two from when you call sometimes even day of. The vet truly cares for my pup and was able to help very much. They are great!

We took our 17-year-old chihuahua, Canela, to AWS Animal Hospital for a dental cleaning, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the care she received. Dr. Joy Carter did an amazing job. She was incredibly patient, answered all of my questions, and took the time to explain everything thoroughly, which gave me so much peace of mind.

Patricia was also so kind and caring with Canela, treating her with such gentleness and compassion. You can truly tell how much they care about their patients.

Thank you both for taking such great care of my pup!

I was out of town when my 9 year old paralyzed Maltese had a urinary blockage. My dog’s acupuncture vet referred me to Dr. Carter at AWS. She was amazing and did the surgery to remove the bladder stones and clear his urethra. The price was extremely reasonable compared to the emergency vet. I am so thankful that she was able to fix his situation and communicate with me long distance. She has followed up with me several times and made sure everything was ok with Scout. I highly recommend AWS Animal Hospital.
I took my dog today for surgery and Dr Carter and Patricia took care of my dog Itachi very well. Excellent service
Miss V. and Dr Carter made me feel so warm and welcome. They made taking care of my Scarlett their top priority. This is definitely going to be my new pet home/veterinarian

Today, February 5, 2026, I called that clinic requesting a service for my mother's dog, who is a 97-year-old disabled person, and the person who answered the phone told me that my mom had to be present when we took our dogs to the clinic, I obviously told them that my mom only can move in ambulance that she couldn't and she said this are the rules and she hung up on me very rudely. That service was terrible, I don't recommend it.
Excellent treatment. The vet was extremely courteous and explain all the details. Prices are very affordable compared to elsewhere. Thank you

The  expertise, professionalism and caring services of the Veterinarians,  surgeons and staff are superior to many other vet offices my Chihuahua has been seen at. Very affordable prices and the most important issue, they won't take advantage of the emergency situations when you as a pet owner have to make difficult decisions.

Extremely attentive since we call the first time to get info about the appointments...
But the best was yet to come... The first impression from the assistant Yvette was great .. I was very nervous because my baby LUNNA is everything for us... She took care of her like it was her dog . The Vet Ms. Jenn Abuan... Great professional and detail oriented ...She let us know everything about the examination and all the steps for the future...

Thank you very much ..
YVETTE & Ms. JENN

Blessings!!
Thanks to Carter's Veterinary Clinic for helping me with my kitten's urinary blockage. I 100% recommend this veterinary clinic. Thank you!

I brought my kitty here hopeless seeking help without no money due to my situation the most that I could pay for was the consultation, but with the help of God a miracle happened and after getting the estimate of what Cherry would need, I posted online to people that I didn’t have the funds and in a few minutes to an hour I couldn’t help but start crying because man I prayed and God was good I managed to gather all the money that i needed and on top of that The Team working there were patient and caring, understanding and helped me work around all the donations I received it, it really  showed that the Dr. & team cared & I’m so very grateful

Brought my cat Cheri and they saved his life. If it wasn’t for the doctors their he would’ve died they also helped my family out with some of financial stuff I really appreciate that since we’re going through a rough spot right now money wise. I really recommend this place. Thank you for the work that the doctors their did to save my kitty’s life.🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻
Manuel is the best professional I have ever met. I will always be very thankful for how well they treated my dear frenchie. Also Patricia was very helpful by keeping an eye in Rocco.

Excellent service, attention, and not to mention the compassion and empathy they have at this clinic for the animals and us parents. My Pomeranian needed femur surgery due to a hip dislocation. The humanity and empathy they have here are incredible. I felt confident, calm, and secure having my dog ​​operated on here, and above all, the price! I finally found a place where they can take care of my dogs' health at a totally affordable price! 🙏 Absolutely everyone who works here, from reception to the surgeon, is professional and empathetic. 100% recommended.
They have always been so kind and acted in the best interests of our pets, despite bills and diagnosis. I'm always so grateful they exist!
Dr Rodriguez was amazing. The entire staff us courteous. Thumbs up!

After searching for so long for the perfect clinic for my dog, I finally found it. The entire staff was wonderful. German was there for my family; sadly, my dog ​​is no longer with us, but he guided and helped us until the very end. Thank you so much 🤍🙏🏽🐶
Amazing team!! Patricia German and Dr. Carter lovely and professional

O ⭐ I left crying they treated me so bad I can't believe they have places like this open
Horrible costumer service
Worst place ever, liars make me go there and gave me a bad experience
Horrible customer service over the phone and in person
I called to make appointment on Monday at 9:00 a.m. just when they opened the front desk girl put me on hold for 25 minutes. When I call back she keeps ending the call. She didn't want to help me
I keep calling and she keep declining the call
She talked bad about me to the other staff members and when I went in person, they didn't want to help me with my dog.
Even though I apologize
because I got angry at the way that she handled  the phone call
They need to teach her how to be professional and how to help customers. She doesn't know anything about customer service. She doesn't care about animals and people.

The prices seemed reasonable and Patricia, Manuel, Dr Kishner, and the gentleman at the front desk, for whom I regrettably didn’t get his name, were all very helpful and kind. We got there before opening time and were out within the hour, the day after a major holiday. I’m very grateful for their care and services.
Amazing, attentive, and caring staff. Gave me options to help me in any way they could. Dr. Davila and Yvette treated my pets and me with much kindness.
Very good, thank you Patricia

I have been bringing my pets here for almost 10 years and I cannot say enough great things about them. The Drs and techs that have seen my pets have all been knowledgeable, professional and compassionate. I have seen them for countless visits, including twice to put 2 of my babies down. I cannot say enough about how kind and compassionate they were during such a rough time for me. Today I saw Dr. Carter and her tech, Yvette (great name!! lol).
They were both kind, efficient, knowledgeable and took care of my Boston terrier, Kiki, quickly and with care. The care and love my pets have received here is second to none without breaking the bank. Highly recommend!!
I highly recommend this vet. Dr. Carter and Delbis are very attentive and caring.

I had to bring my very sick cat, Pierre, to this facility and I had a deeply upsetting experience with one technician named Valeria.

During an emotionally difficult visit, she discussed my cat’s medical condition openly in the lobby, in front of other people with no privacy or sensitivity. She seemed detached and showed NO empathy. I was already in distress, and I felt dismissed, unsupported, and exposed.

When you’re facing a sick or dying pet, communication, compassion, and basic respect matter. Medical care isn’t just about treatment, it’s about how you treat people during fragile moments.

I hope leadership sees this and seriously improves training for staff regarding empathy, client privacy, and professional communication.

On Tuesday, my sweet Canela Rodríguez had her surgery, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the experience. From the moment we walked in, the environment felt warm, calm, and full of genuine care.

The entire team showed an incredible level of compassion and professionalism. Manuel and Patricia treated Canela as if she were their own, comforting her with so much love. Dr. Carter and Dr. Kushnir were amazing—patient, attentive, and truly dedicated to making sure everything went perfectly.

Thanks to them, Canela is recovering beautifully, and I feel so much peace knowing she was in such wonderful hands.
I highly, highly recommend this clinic to anyone who wants their pet to be treated with real love and heart. ❤️🐾

Excellent service, always friendly, and the doctors are always very understanding.
The assistants are fabulous.
I'm very happy with this clinic.

Thank you to Dr. Carter and her assistant, Yvette, for the professional care they provided to my cat Frida. The service, cleanliness, and follow-up are exceptional. We’ve been visiting the clinic for six years and have always been very satisfied. Highly recommended. Thank you!

I truly appreciate the doctors and nurses at this location — they’ve always treated my pet and me with care and professionalism. However, the woman at the front desk (the older blonde) needs to learn how to properly communicate with clients who are already going through stressful situations. A little empathy and professionalism go a long way, especially when people are paying for services.

This past Saturday, I was scheduled for my baby’s stitch removal. When I arrived, I was told it was four days too early. A nurse kindly told me it would be fine to return on Wednesday, so I planned accordingly and even took time off work. But when I called to confirm, the front desk woman tried to push the appointment back again — and when I calmly asked why, she became defensive and rude instead of offering an explanation.

It’s frustrating when different staff members say different things, and the person at the front desk takes it out on the customer. I wasn’t being rude — I was simply trying to understand why I kept being rescheduled. People have jobs and responsibilities, and not everyone can just keep rearranging their time because of internal miscommunication.

I hope management addresses this, because the medical team here is great — but the front desk’s attitude gives the wrong impression and makes an already stressful situation worse.
Terrible terrible. Don’t go here if you love your pet.

I took my cat to this vet and had the worst experience ever. I took her and she was doing terrible, they put her in a medication and told me to call when it was close to refill to pick up the rest. After I called them when the medication was about to be done they said that they couldn’t assist her and completely dismissed her. Completely out of line behavior. Don’t bring your pet here. They just don’t care.

Brought in our stray kitty to AWSFL, the entire staff were very accommodating. Yvette and Dr Kushnir were very compassionate, friendly, and caring. You can really tell that they genuinely care about the animals, they are knowledgeable and above all understanding.
Very caring and helpful.

I took my dog ​​in a year ago because he had a lump. When they examined him, they said it needed to be removed. The surgery cost $2,000, and they helped me get financial assistance from a foundation. The wound was poorly sutured and reopened completely within two days. I had to take him back for another appointment, and when I called to schedule a consultation with the same doctor who had operated on him, the receptionist told me there was no availability with that doctor and that if I didn't like it, I should go somewhere else, saying they had already helped me a lot.

A year later, I was trying to schedule another appointment because my dog ​​has a lump again, and they told me to wait on hold. After waiting an hour, I hung up and called back, and now I'm just getting voicemail.
The help I received was from a foundation that specializes in this, not from the veterinary clinic. Furthermore, if they're going to offer help, they shouldn't have to emphasize it every chance they get. I'm disappointed with the customer service at this place.

I cannot thank them enough for all they’ve done! You can tell how much love and effort they put into their work. From the doctors to the nurses and the front desk ladies, they all helped me and my kitty every step. 10 stars!
An amazing place to bring your loved one , great staff very friendly , doctors are amazing the save my dog life , great experience better than private clinics
Excellent service

Today I took my took my dear Yuli, she’s been sick with stomach and intestinal issues. The staff, doctors and everyone were so kind and professional. Specially Manuel and Dr Davila such a great team! Great support, knowledgeable and very professional. The best team :) thank you for taking amazing care of us🫶🙏🏻
They take care of us right away even before appointment time and they really care about your pet👍💯

This clinic wasted our time and showed no consideration. They told us to bring our dog in without explaining the surgeon is only there Monday–Thursday. We drove a long way, arrived before 1pm (they close at 3), and were turned away because they were at “full capacity,” even though the lobby was empty. This should have been communicated over the phone. Please be more considerate towards the pets and the time of their owners.
In the past they have been great went there yesterday and had a real nasty Doctor who actually told me not to ever come back that I was banned from there

Literally they saved my dog. I have a 12 year old yorky who was fainting and seriously ill I took her to two other well known vets in coconut grove they told me she needed $5,000 in X-rays and other diagnostics before they would treat my dog. I went to  animal welfare on 27th Avenue for a third opinion Dr Arlene Martinez and her technician Manuel Jaime spent hours with my dog and did take blood test and other samples and immediately gave my dog prescription medicine and changed her food and my weak very sick dog came back to her old self. wagging her tail and happy again. I am so grateful for their care and attention they are good honest  doctors and team. I highly recommend them. As without them I fear my dog would have perished. Thank you so much!!

I can’t thank them enough for the care they gave my 18-year-old dog. At her age, every visit feels so important, and they treated her with such kindness and patience. They took the time to explain everything clearly to me, gave thoughtful advice, and made sure my girl was as comfortable as possible during the whole process. It’s not easy watching her age, but having a vet that I can trust makes all the difference. I truly appreciate them and Yvette was so nice and kind and helped me with all the emotions I was handling about my dog Bella.
Thanks! For helping my cat ❤️

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Animal Welfare.  From the very beginning they ave shown extraordinary kindness, compassion and Professionalism.

When my Yorkie, Phoebe, was just a puppy just under a year she had Parvo. When I rescued her.  They saved her life.  I will forever be grateful care ad dedication she received during that critical time.  They also treated my beloved Morkie Piper which she had a heart murmur and she had an extended life thanks to there referral to a great cardiologist.   They help me with her though many emergency visits when she was sick and help with her quality of life.   Word’s cannot express the gratitude I feel for the staffs support  and everything they have done for my pets.  I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone who wants the best for their furry family members.  They are the best!!!!!❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
Dr. Martinez and Genrman were fantastic. They took great care of are cat Lucy, and treated with love amd care.

Dr. Carter and the team at animal welfare are so caring, kind, and knowledgeable. She explained what was going on with our Daisy perfectly and gave recommendations that made a noticeable difference in her condition after I went home. Daisy had been having several bouts of diarrhea, vomiting, and even bloody stools and an allergic reaction prior. I had taken her to 3 vets prior to this. Although I am no expert in veterinary medicine, as a healthcare provider, I have an idea of the terminology and medications being given. Dr. Carters suggestions seemed the most reasonable and effective and she made it clear that her communication line was open. Becca, Manuel, and German are also invaluable and very caring members of the Animal Welfare team. Thank you so much for helping my Daisy.

Reasonable care pricing and very upfront no gimicks. Technician Ivetter was very personable and attentive to my pets needs and took care to explain my options after dr Davila  examined my female calico cat and he advised a sensitive plan for a yard cat understanding some care options are impossible to execute. I really appreciate such a sensible approach for pet care for street cats.  Also very clean facilities and attentive staff.

I cannot express the gratitude I have for AWS. I took my rescue dog here after i found her with a fracture from getting hit by a car and abandoned. All the employees here are truly animal lovers. The care your pet receives here is honest and no-frills. They give you what you need for a happy healthy dog, nothing more nothing less. Their pricing is probably the most affordable i have seen from a vet. $35 for bandage, $20 for a splint, $55 for a general consult, $45 for sedation and recovery, $175 for radiographs — these are all insanely affordable in my experience. The pet ER was charging $300 for sedation alone and $150 for bandaging. They always inform you of the price you pay before they proceed with the care, so there are no surprises. My dog’s splint came off (she is very active and energetic) and they did not charge me for a rebandage, since it is not supposed to come off. AWS is such a god send. I don’t know how I would have been able to afford this rescue without them. Cost aside, they really do care about your pets as well. They have taken such good care of both me and my dog. I cannot express enough how grateful I am to everyone at AWS. I would recommend them over and over again every time!

My visit today was phenomenal. Doctor Carter and Technician Yvette were super understanding and very empathetic. They were so kind to my dog and cat and were able to swiftly provide services needed. I left today with exactly what I needed to combat these pesky fleas. I would highly recommend to anyone in need of Specialized care for their loved pets.

I was there yesterday morning, and a woman with a terrible attitude served me. I needed my pet's record, which she gave me in an arrogant manner. I don't know why people like that work in customer service. I paid $600 to be treated like that. That's too bad because the doctors are very good.
Fantastic job helped lelo alot with her leg will be back incase any future problems there very nice and helpful
Amazing Vet, definitely recommended thank you to Dr Gonzalez and German for the amazing service

I cannot express how much gratitude I have for the doctors and staff at AWSFL! The professionalism and kindness they extended to myself and my family to assist through a very troubling emergency situation was a true blessing. They absolutely went above and beyond. Thank you.

I used to bring my dog here and stopped because it was too far. When i went to other vets, I was never happy with the service. This is the reason why i came back. Dr González, Yvette and Delvis are very caring and truly care about the animals. The entire staff is very friendly and always willing to help. I highly recommend to bring your pets here. In addition, they have great prices.

AWS has been taking great care of Rusty since he was a puppy, 10 years ago.

They explained from the very beginning that they were bringing in my pets for me, and yet instead of calmly explaining the authorization policy, the blonde receptionist responded with hostility and impatience. Her repeated comments were said with an unnecessary and dismissive attitude. She made no attempt to help—just rushed them out as though they were an inconvenience.

To make matters worse, when I called to follow up and try to understand what happened, the same woman lied and claimed that my sister and mom didn’t give her enough time to explain. That couldn’t be further from the truth. From their account, it was clear she had no intention of explaining anything—she practically chased them off with her attitude.

As a paying client, I expect not only proper care for my pets but also respectful treatment of those representing me. The fact that both my mother and sister were treated so poorly is unacceptable. I will no longer be using this clinic and will be seeking out a more professional and compassionate veterinary office. Respect and honesty should be the bare minimum. Basic courtesy should not be optional.

I recently visited this veterinary clinic on behalf of my sister, who was unable to attend due to work. From the moment we walked in, the receptionist—an English-speaking blonde woman—was shockingly rude and unwelcoming. We explained right away that the cats were not ours and that we were bringing them in for someone else. Rather than kindly guiding us through the process or explaining the policy about needing prior authorization, she immediately seemed irritated and rushed the interaction.

She asked for the account phone number, then repeatedly asked for my name and my mother’s name with a visible attitude. After each response, she curtly snapped, “That’s not on the account,” even though we had already clarified that we were not the pet owners. Finally, she told us, “Well you can’t because you aren’t authorized,” in a condescending tone, leaving no room for further communication or assistance. It genuinely felt like she was having a bad day and chose to take it out on us.

We ultimately left because of how poorly we were treated. What struck me most is that I’m usually the type of person who overlooks minor rudeness, but this was so blatant and uncomfortable that it couldn’t be ignored. I was even considering bringing my own pets here in the future, but after that experience, I will absolutely be taking them elsewhere. It honestly felt like she hated her job and didn’t want to be there.

This clinic may have great veterinarians, but first impressions matter—and front desk interactions set the tone. I hope the staff is reminded of the importance of professionalism and basic courtesy, especially when clients are already coming in under stressful circumstances.
